headlines.summary: 据新华社报道，近日，记者深入多地一线调研发现，“稳楼市”政策持续显效，市场信心和预期逐步改善，刚性和改善性住房需求有序释放，房地产市场继续保持稳的态势。 “去库存”是打通市场堵点、释放有效供给的重要举措。从土地端看，2026年上半年，“控量提质”成为全国土地市场的主基调。在“控增量”“去库存”的同时，“优供给”引导住宅新增供给向高品质升级，进一步提升激活需求。

headlines.title_en: The property market is showing stronger signs of bottoming out and stabilizing, with an accelerated shift in development models
headlines.summary_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, recent field surveys across multiple regions show that 'stabilizing the property market' policies are continuously taking effect, with market confidence and expectations gradually improving, rigid and improvement-driven housing demand being released in an orderly manner, and the real estate market maintaining a stable trend. 'Inventory reduction' is a key measure to clear market bottlenecks and unlock effective supply. On the land supply side, 'controlling volume and improving quality' became the main theme of the national land market in the first half of 2026. While 'controlling new supply' and 'reducing inventory', 'optimizing supply' guides new residential supply towards higher quality upgrades, further stimulating demand.

headlines.title: IMF总裁会见米莱，570亿美元账单到期
headlines.summary: 克里斯塔利娜·格奥尔基耶娃（Kristalina Georgieva）抵达阿根廷首都布宜诺斯艾利斯，亲自考察总统哈维尔·米莱的经济复苏成果。目前阿根廷债券价格上涨，通胀下降，央行正在重建现金储备。格奥尔基耶娃对阿根廷最终有望走出反复借贷的恶性循环表示乐观，并认为在2027年总统大选前，阿根廷无需向IMF寻求额外融资。 阿根廷将于9月开始向IMF偿还本金，还款计划将持续至2042年。IMF前官员表示，米莱若想彻底摆脱对IMF的依赖，几乎需要所有环节都万无一失。

headlines.title_en: IMF Managing Director meets with Milei as $57 billion bill comes due
headlines.summary_en: Kristalina Georgieva arrived in Buenos Aires, the capital of Argentina, to personally assess the economic recovery achievements of President Javier Milei. Currently, Argentine bond prices are rising, inflation is declining, and the central bank is rebuilding cash reserves. Georgieva expressed optimism that Argentina may finally break free from the vicious cycle of repeated borrowing and believes the country will not need additional financing from the IMF before the 2027 presidential election. Argentina will begin repaying principal to the IMF in September, with the repayment plan extending until 2042. A former IMF official stated that for Milei to completely escape reliance on the IMF, almost every aspect would need to go flawlessly.

headlines.summary_en: Citigroup traders are betting that the Federal Reserve will keep interest rates unchanged this week, despite swap markets pricing in over a one-third probability of a 25-basis-point rate hike. headlines.title_en: 68 enterprises sign up for the 10th China International Import Expo
headlines.summary_en: On the 100-day countdown to the 9th China International Import Expo (CIIE), the launch ceremony for exhibitor recruitment for the 10th CIIE was held at the National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai). At the ceremony, 68 enterprises signed up to participate in the 10th CIIE, with contracted exhibition area exceeding 50,000 square meters. headlines.title_en: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission: Will deepen central enterprise 'AI+' special action, accelerate computing infrastructure construction
headlines.summary_en: During the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference, the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC) of the State Council officially released the second batch of high-value strategic AI scenarios and high-quality industry datasets for central enterprises at the 'AI Empowers New Quality, Full Domain Renewal' enterprise AI high-quality development forum. It also launched the AI open-source 'Renewal Community' 2.0 and initiated the State-owned Central Enterprise Intelligent Software Factory Joint Foundation Project.
